content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Deviation — §12.4 (p0045).** The clause is a one-way no-hire on Customer covering *all* Vendor employees for 24 months, with the general-advertising/unsolicited-application carve-out affirmatively excluded ("regardless of how the employee applies"). It fails the fallback (mutual, involved personnel only, 12 months, carve-outs, no no-hire) on every material term and sits in walk-away territory; it also contradicts §12.3's acknowledgement that Customer made no no-hire commitment. Redline validated: delete §12.4, with the narrow mutual 12-month non-solicit offered as fallback in the comment.
